name: Nick Leiserson
biography: Nick Leiserson is Legislative Director to Congressman Jim Langevin (RI-02), a senior member of the House Armed Services and Homeland Security Committees and the co-founder of the Congressional Cybersecurity Caucus. Leiserson serves as Rep. Langevin's principal advisor on an array of issues, particularly homeland security; judiciary; and technology policy. He holds a degree in computer science from Brown University.
